verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a bare "Webhook Events" feature line on the Medusa Cloud pricing page (medusa-docs-16). It suggests webhook subscriptions exist, but nothing describes how they work. Missing for 10: documentation of how to register webhook subscriptions, the list of supported event types, payload format and signing/verification, retry and delivery guarantees, whether this works outside Medusa Cloud, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
